# Entry presentation

## Options

<!-- mant:entries role=option case=sensitive -->
- `-x LANG`, `--language=LANG`: Select language; repeat -x when needed. <!-- mant:entry {"id":"language","aliasGroups":[["-x","--language"]]} -->
- `--other`: Use -x with this other option.
- `--dialect LANG`: Independent related entry. <!-- mant:entry {"id":"dialect","aliasOf":"language"} -->

## Commands

<!-- mant:entries role=command case=insensitive -->
- `Launch`: Start the task.

## Markers

<!-- mant:entries role=marker case=sensitive -->
- `--`: End option parsing.

## Operands

<!-- mant:entries role=operand case=sensitive -->
- `-`: Read standard input.

## Variables

<!-- mant:entries role=variable case=sensitive -->
- `$local_name`: A local variable.

## Environment

<!-- mant:entries role=environment-variable case=insensitive -->
- `$Env:HOME`: A documented environment name, not a runtime lookup.

## Configuration

<!-- mant:entries role=configuration-key case=sensitive -->
- `ServerAliveInterval`: Configure the interval.

## Values

<!-- mant:entries role=value case=sensitive -->
- `automatic`: Select automatically.

## Terms

<!-- mant:entries role=term case=sensitive -->
- `alpha`: A glossary term.

## Ordinary content

-xylophone is not an option here. Use -x for the language.
